It is bifurcated into Andheri (west) and Andheri (east). Andheri (west) comes under K/W ward of the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC), while Andheri (east) comes under the K/E ward of BMC. ## Economy Andheri east and west are key areas in Mumbai, where several film studios and TV news channels are located. Andheri West has the head office of PVR INOX.
